how: hand-written programs, not generated cells — each is the minimal witness of ONE rung's price in D300's ablation (silent-class-inventory D300, #1986). Materialised directly into scripts/silent-sweep/distilled/named/, so no mkset.py step: there is no grid to re-derive them from.
note: WHY THESE ARE A NAMED SET AND NOT A DERIVED ONE. D300 landed three rungs — R (the kind-1 hoist), X (the kind-6 hoist), T (the chained `mvCanonRepOf`). The 1,477-cell derived corpus prices R and X: without them 27 of D300's own named cells stay check-clean invalid wasm. It prices T at ZERO — `R` alone and `R+X` both grade 174/207 rows -> runs with 0 runs LOST across all 2,006 graded programs, and both are a COMPILER TRAP on a real corpus program. What T holds up is a population the census does not contain (two INDEPENDENT declared families whose arms are layout twins, both fed by one inferred map spelling), so nothing reading current behaviour can find it. The two programs below carry that price into the 7-second gate.

d300t_two_families_non_transitive.why: A layout-only twin rung is SOUND but not TRANSITIVE — the union of two equivalences is not one. `mvCanonRepOf` returned the FIRST twin on the stated premise that it was; the heap mint chains. The two then disagree, two ref-list slots the mint treats as one resolve different wrappers, and the `map-value layout twins resolved different vals wrappers` interlock fires — an `emitFail`, which does NOT halt, so its -1 becomes `typeOffset` and the emit walks off a parallel table. Also a pin: it has run on every shipped compiler.
d300t_two_families_non_transitive.twin_in_corpus: tests/cases/maps/map-value-twin-relation-stays-transitive.vl (and tests/cases/maps/inferred-map-destination-shape.vl, the corpus file whose RCDIFF found this)

d300x_nested_one_container_out.why: The kind-6 arm's own guard IS `rlSlotsLayoutTwin`, whose kind-3 element recursion bottoms out in the pair the kind-1 hoist merges — so with R alone the INNER merge lands and the OUTER map keeps two byte-identical map structs. R and X are one landing.

refused.candidate: the kind-1 hoist asked through `rlSlotsLayoutTwin` instead of ref-list slot EQUALITY
refused.price: 4 behavioural classes / 21 census cells `runs` -> `loud emit reject` (b021395 [4], b021396 [3], b021398 [9], b021399 [5]), all `emitProgram: bare null needs a struct-typed context`
refused.buys: NOTHING — its mover set on the derived corpus is cell-identical to the shipped rung's (174 rows either way) and it closes the same 17 of D300's 27
refused.mechanism: `rlSlotsLayoutTwin`'s cross-table arm merges an ARM-valued slot with a plain-struct slot, and `mvCanonRepOf` is also the chokepoint for `mvValStructIdxOf` / `mvValVariantOf` — so the store-side seed switches from `svCtx.structIdx` to `svCtx.variantIdx` and the bare `null` in `{ r: null }` loses its struct-typed context. The four classes are already BLOCKING in distilled/cells/, so this price needs no extra named cell; it is recorded here so the next reader does not pay it again.
